description: Sort a brand folder or zip you already uploaded (up to 200 files): logos in every version, fonts, a guide PDF, posts and photos. Code reads each file first, then AI looks at the pictures and reads the guide. Each file comes back with the slot it fits and how sure we are, and nothing changes in a brand until you call apply_import. Free, within the daily import allowance. Answers with the run; read it with get_folder_import.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this call. Send the SAME one again after a lost answer to get the first answer back, with nothing spent twice.

name: import_folder
title: Read a whole brand folder
